Introduction
This document 
outlines the testing procedures

Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, quality control general director 
and supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear your safety equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
Equipment isolation which its protection relay under test.

Tools and Equipment
Current injection 
 device with timer.
Test plug, test leads, 
 variable rheostat
Test cabinet.
Work to be Carried Out
Connect a variable source of voltage at 
 rated frequency to the coil.
Checking the pickup and drop out voltage.
The relay should be adjusted by means of 
 the variable rheostat.
Record the measured value in the test 
 sheet.
Return Relay into Service
Return the relay 
 to the panel.
Withdraw the test plug 
 handle from the relay.
Return all connections to the normal position as before 
 the test.
Place a copy of the test result in the field maintenance file.
Close the work permit.
